from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EarningsPerShareRecord(BaseModel):
    """An EPS figure extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name reported in the document header/registrant section")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the line item, e.g., 'Basic Earnings Per Share', 'Basic net loss per share'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the EPS; losses are negative")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[EarningsPerShareRecord]
